verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes can be driven programmatically through documented SDK APIs. The Python reference covers the `Sandbox` object, its `exec` and logs APIs, network and resource parameters, snapshots and probes, and JS/Go SDK guides show creating and executing in sandboxes. Community builders corroborate programmatic control, including gRPC-driven sandboxes and GitHub Actions runners. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed openapi paths return 404), and full platform coverage in the JS/Go SDKs, which reach only "some" platform resources.
